_comment: When each older Layers cite was last proven checked against its source, for cites with no record of the day they were read. A credit built from this file says 'checked against the source by <the PR's merge date>; the date it was read was not recorded'. It never gives a read date.

How it was found: config/layers.json was read at each of the 25 commits that touched it. A cite's check is the first commit of the latest unbroken run in which the cite is present (git log -S per cite; plain git blame is wrong here because two commits re-sorted whole sections), mapped to its PR through the first-parent merges of main. Re-derive it with docs/evidence/tools/checks_from_git.py. The PR bodies and commit messages say what each check was; the commits are listed so anyone can read them.

records: [passage, note (0-based index in its passage's layers), note kind, source, on, at, pr], naming each cite as config/layers.json gives it on 2026-10-21 (sources cited by their works now give only the place inside the work in at).

prs.check: Each citation's page was fetched and quoted, then fetched again and checked against the source; 46 that failed were corrected or dropped.
Both quotes were checked against the fetched pages.
Each quote was matched word for word against a downloaded copy of the text (1,516 of 1,517); the 33 Bible Hub quotes were fetched again.

All 3,217 quotes held locally were matched word for word against the source copies (sacred-texts files, the Companion Bible and Figures of Speech databases, Wesley); the cites added in 05fe581 were fetched and their wording confirmed.
All 15 quotes from local copies were found word for word; the 6 web quotes were read again on their pages.
prs.against: a copy of the text and the page
